boundary: Same-owner workflow and mutation evidence only; no independent reproduction or protected-gate closure.

closeout_methods.recovery: Retain the silent wrapper at zero credit and verify the exact evidence head, direct x1 parent, commit subject, empty staged and unstaged diffs, and clean untracked state with separate no-profile scalar reads before pushing.
closeout_methods.recurrence_guard: Never infer a commit result from an empty wrapper; require an attributable exact-head and parent projection before the next lifecycle step.
closeout_methods.rollback: Do not push or begin closeout unless the separate read proves the exact expected evidence commit and a clean tree.

closeout_methods.recovery: Retain the malformed combined probe at zero credit, then inspect structured JSON fields directly and run each remaining stale-label literal as a separate bounded ASCII-safe search.
closeout_methods.recurrence_guard: Do not embed quote-bearing JSON fragments in a PowerShell ripgrep loop; use parsed JSON fields or independent simple literal searches.
closeout_methods.rollback: The failed read-only probe changed no repository bytes; do not infer stale-label status until the corrected bounded reads pass.

closeout_methods.recovery: Retain the parser failure at zero credit, brace the variable name in the diagnostic-only error string, and rerun the same exact index-blob, JSON, manifest, privacy, and diff-hygiene checks.
closeout_methods.recurrence_guard: Use ${name} before a literal colon inside PowerShell interpolated strings.
closeout_methods.rollback: The parser rejected the read-only diagnostic before execution; award no staged-review credit until the corrected invocation passes.

closeout_methods.recovery: Retain the silent aggregate at zero credit, write one bounded exact-index receipt to the owner-local external validation bank, then independently reread and validate its explicit fields before using it.
closeout_methods.recurrence_guard: A silent wrapper never earns pass credit; require a persisted explicit valid field and a separate bounded receipt reread.
closeout_methods.rollback: Leave the staged tree unchanged and stop before commit if the external receipt is absent, malformed, non-attributable, or invalid.

closeout_methods.recovery: Retain the pre-shell orchestration failure and the later quote-transport failure at zero credit, then use a dependency-free controlled external helper whose exact-index receipt is independently reread and validated.
closeout_methods.recurrence_guard: Do not assume browser or Node encoding globals exist in the orchestration isolate; prefer a controlled external helper for multiline diagnostics that also contain nested quotes.
closeout_methods.rollback: No shell or repository process started; leave the staged tree unchanged and require an explicit external receipt on recovery.

closeout_methods.recovery: Retain the rejected inline-code transport at zero credit and execute the unchanged bounded diagnostic from a controlled owner-local external helper file, then independently reread its receipt.
closeout_methods.recurrence_guard: Use a controlled external helper file instead of PowerShell python -c for multiline quote-bearing diagnostics.
closeout_methods.rollback: The syntax error created no receipt and changed no staged bytes; stop before commit unless the file-backed diagnostic and receipt reread both pass.

closeout_methods.recovery: Retain the rejected read-only summary at zero credit and repeat only the count projection with a nonreserved descriptive variable name.
closeout_methods.recurrence_guard: Never use true, false, null, host, home, or other automatic PowerShell names for local diagnostic variables.
closeout_methods.rollback: The assignment was rejected before the summary ran and changed no repository bytes; do not infer count parity until the corrected projection passes.
